pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Complex polygonal dark regions with variable spatial area; smaller, more densely packed patches on the lower neck transitioning to larger, irregular polygons on the flank. Edges exhibit moderate angularity, though pixel gradients are softened by image resolution.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pathways. Node junctions are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-flank, with some narrowing observed on the neck segment.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder. The mane presents as a fine, high-frequency jagged contour against the background.
